# OORO

> OORO is building a mobility advertising platform for digital screens inside participating autos and other vehicles. Bengaluru, Karnataka is its initial launch focus.

This file is a short index for systems that consume Markdown site indexes. For current product and company facts, use the linked public pages. A city or neighbourhood preference does not guarantee route coverage, screen availability, impressions, audience reach or campaign results; confirm inventory and terms with OORO.

## Company

- Company: OORO
- Category: mobility advertising and digital out-of-home (DOOH)
- Initial launch focus: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Founders: Varneeth Varma Nandimandalam (Founder & CEO); Siri Girish (Co-founder & CMO); Jay Chandrudu Thammadi (Co-founder, Hardware & Operations)
- Current availability: confirmed per campaign request

## What the product does

OORO helps businesses submit a campaign brief and creative, review eligibility and available screens, confirm dates and commercial terms, and review playback information where supported. QR engagement is reported separately from playback and only where data is available.

## Measurement limits

- A campaign assignment does not itself establish that a creative played.
- Playback records describe screen-level delivery where reporting is supported.
- Playback records do not prove unique passengers, attention, store visits or sales.
- QR scans are engagement events; they are not equivalent to impressions or proof of play.
- Planning estimates are distinct from directly observed delivery evidence.
